items.desc_now: DSH Web 插件 · 提示词优化器（SPEC v0.5 依据驱动架构）：把用户的一句话补成『带依据的执行指令』——依据只搬不造（原话／会话上下文／项目文件，每条事实带出处），只补五类缺口（指代定位／验收判据／约束边界／隐含决定／入口锚点），档位＝依据预算，默认面向 PTC 执行体。不写形式模板与验证套话。
items.desc_prev: DSH Web 插件 · 提示词优化器：把用户的一句话补全成完整具体的要求说明（面向 PTC 模式）。0.4 = 需求补全器——只补内容，不写流程/步骤/验收清单/验证纪律/禁令。

items.desc_now: DSH Web session manager: delete, archive, move across workspaces, migrate preset; favorites, review-later, search, sort, priority, add tags and notes (manual / semi-automated). Suggestions are welcome on GitHub.
items.desc_prev: Session manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: delete sessions, move sessions across workspaces, and migrate a session's Agent preset.

items.desc_now: Floating todo progress ball for DSH: live done/total + active task, status colours, draggable, Shadow-DOM isolated, dual-channel sync, history archive (cleanup/restore/copy), pinned sessions, layout switch, discipline injection + first-call gate, 128 shared skins, web + desktop. 常驻 todo 进度悬浮球：实时进度/状态色/历史归档/固定会话/布局切换/纪律注入+首调用硬门/128 皮肤统一，双端可用。
items.desc_prev: Floating progress ball for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): keeps the AI agent's todo_write checklist on a persistent, draggable ball with live status colors. EN/CN bilingual.

items.desc_now: Custom modes and custom prompts for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): edit a mode's system prompt in the settings page, choose its base mode, switch plugins row by row, and keep several assistants (multi-mode) side by side.
items.desc_prev: Custom agent modes for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): manage many assistants from one settings page, each with its own editable system prompt, base mode and per-row plugin switches.

items.desc_now: Enhanced DSH archive manager: favorites filter & prune, one-click delete unfavorited, pinning, time & turns sorting, idle-days one-click archive (progress & undo), fast bulk delete with progress & fallback, copy ID/path, reworked layout. Based on MichengAI v0.1.40 (Apache-2.0). 归档会话增强版：收藏/置顶/时间·轮次排序/闲置一键归档/快速批量删除/复制 ID·路径。
items.desc_prev: Archived-sessions plugin for DSH — enhanced build by loyalchiiina: favorites, pinning, turns sort, idle auto-archive, bulk delete. Installable package (lib/ + README + NOTICE); based on MichengAI's upstream dsh-archive-manager v0.1.40 (Apache-2.0).
